title.narrative: Feasibility of Municipal Solid Waste processing for recycling and green energy generation in Kenya

description.narrative: Two Dutch companies, engineers who provide technical advice/design, are involved in this application.The applicant Adverio Waste Systems B.V. (AWS) focuses on the separation of household waste into recyclable materials and organic fractions.Adverio Engineering B.V. focuses on the further processing of the organic residual flows and the production of biogas and biofertiliser by means of anaerobic digestion.The designs of AWS and Adverio Engineering for waste separation and biogas production can be adapted to the specific composition of local waste flows and the contextual requirements. They work together with Dutch partners who can supply the right equipment for their projects.Wanergy (Africa) Ltd. is a Kenyan company, a so-called Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) that has been set up for the development and exploitation of a waste-to-energy project. This project involves an integrated municipal solid waste (MSW) and biodigester facility in Nairobi with a processing capacity of between 400 and 600 tons of municipal solid waste per day. After separation of the waste streams, non-organic recyclables are sold to local recycling companies, while organic waste is converted into biogas through anaerobic digestion. The biogas produced will be further upgraded to biomethane, which can then be compressed for distribution to the thousands of public transport buses and vans, replacing fossil fuels. Part of the biogas produced will be converted into electricity and heat via a combined heat and power plant (a combined heat/energy plant) to produce energy for the facility. The digestate, a by-product of the fermentation, will be processed into high-quality organic fertiliser, as an alternative to the use of artificial fertilisers in the agricultural sector.Wanergy needs a thorough feasibility study to come to a final investment decision and to attract investors who will participate in the Wanergy entity.
